title: Seven Months of Playing. Thousands Spent. Here's What I Learned.
body: I played this game for seven months and spent thousands of dollars. About three months in, I began tracking rewards, outcomes, progression, and the value of purchases because something wasn’t adding up. What I observed was disturbing. As I progressed, the cost of continuing increased dramatically, while the rewards and progress I received relative to my spending appeared to decline. There were periods when the game seemed generous and progress felt achievable, followed by stretches where meaningful rewards became increasingly rare and I repeatedly landed on basic tiles. After months of tracking these patterns, I no longer believe the experience offers reasonable value for the money it encourages players to spend. I cannot prove how the algorithm works behind the scenes, but I can speak to my experience and the results I documented. My advice: Be extremely cautious about spending money on this game. What starts as harmless entertainment can becomeq an extraordinarily expensive pursuit of rewards that never seem to materialize. After seven months and thousands of dollars, I’m walking away. I wish I’d done it sooner.

Final Verdict Coin Master: Board Adventure needs to rethink how it treats the players who literally fund their game. title: Fun but friend invited needs to be fixed
body: The game itself is fun and offers lots of different ways to earn energy without having to spend money, which I really appreciate. My issue is with the friend invite system. I invited a friend, but because we are connected through Facebook, he automatically appeared on my friends list in the game. Since he was already listed as a friend, I couldn’t complete the “invite a friend” step. Customer support told me I didn’t receive credit because I didn’t complete every step of the process, but I couldn’t complete the last step due to the Facebook connection. I explained this to support, but they were unwilling to help or offer any solution. It’s frustrating because the game is enjoyable, but the invite system and customer service experience need improvement. This keeps the review little less than fair: you praise the fun parts while clearly explaining the issue and why you’re frustrated, which usually carries more weight than a full-blown rage review. Humans tend to listen better when you don’t sound like you’re trying to launch the game into the sun. I explain the issue to coin masters rep again and they are not willing to compensate for the problem I had with the friend invite. I everything required except the last step because of the Facebook friend are automatically added to friends list. This is not my fault for not finishing the last step. For this reason I am leaving my review at two stars!

body: I’ve been using smartphones for 20 years and this is the greediest game I’ve ever played - by far. I played for a few minutes just now and had to tap away 29 different “pay us” windows. I get it - you’re a business - but every single time I’m out of coins, energy, potions, tokens, credits, disks, fuel, etc??? Also when you have a time-limited bonus, at least half of the time is wasted with useless animations for tiny “rewards”. There’s no way this is accidental. Game play is entertaining and there’s no shortage of variety. In fact there’s a new mini-game inside every day. That can be good or bad. Sometimes it’s fun. Sometimes it feels chaotic. title: Tester up
body: Downloaded this game thru tester up app. It is buggy, but they often update regularly. Here are my observations: Pig Game April 17, 2026 @ 9:54am It’s enjoyable, but I wish there were more ways to grind for food for your pet. Everything seems to pop up money to keep playing or for easier gameplay, but it would be nice if you could just have an area where you can mash buttons to get what do you need. I like the way the Monopoly part of the gameplay, where you can push the spin button yourself or have the dice roll automatically. I like that it keeps checking in on you to make sure that you’re still there so you have to do something to advance the game. I like the war feature because when you raid you’re just hitting a little lightning boat at the person and you don’t hear screaming and see bodies flying or anything like that. The card trading is an interesting part of the game and all of the mini games really make the game worth playing. April 19, 2026 @ 10:26am Started playing the game, but decided to do the update close the app and went through testerup and did the update and the App Store. The pig runs around and then you tap the screen for raid, tap again for money, then the pig runs around. It’s a cute side distraction like a fidget spinner, but not really a game. April 24, 2026 @ 00:23 I didn’t think I would have another entry for the game, but they did this thing where they give you an incredibly large amount of coins like in the millions and then they also give you thousands of spins, but instead of making you click the button each time or even waiting through the auto clicker, they give you a multiplier on the side, which is an incredible time saver. We should at least be able to change pets hair color or modify in some way. Game then broke where the whole board went missing and you had just the outer ring of mini games. Stayed that way for a few minutes until I rebooted. April 29, 2026 @ 11:25 am This game just keeps on surprising me. They put a literal game of craps in the side bar. You bet with your coins and when you run out you can buy more. It’s more gambling than the monopoly style roll of the dice 🎲 of the main board. May 1, 2026 @ 10:47 am Yet another update. The mini games are getting out of control. The screen is so cluttered there’s a scroll bar. One side of the screen is for purchases. I appreciate the separation. There’s no way to make it to level 190 in 30 days without spending money LOL May 5, 2026 @ 23:59 The game froze on me in terms of the pig running 🐷 but the timer kept counting down on my boost. I was able to change screens at first and get a roll or two, but then even that stopped working. Boost ran out and I had to close and reopen the game. May 9, 2026 @ 10:43 am I like how they give you energy if you already have something that you rolled, like the shields. That’s nice. The game feels really fair in the amount of chances you get and the notifications. There are several ways to earn or gain energy, not just paying all the time. Quite nice and no ad popups.
